title: Boot loop after an update
symptom: PC keeps restarting during startup after an update
user_description: After last night's updates my PC just restarts over and over. It shows the logo, then goes black and starts again. I have a presentation at 2!

options.why: Wipes the PC and maybe his files, when recovery tools can often fix this without losing anything.

options.text: Keep switching it off and on until it starts
options.why: Repeated hard power-offs can make things worse and do not fix the cause.

options.text: Use the Windows Recovery Environment: try Startup Repair, uninstall the latest update or use System Restore, and recover his data before anything drastic
options.why: A bad update is the likely cause. Recovery tools can remove it or roll back, and keeping the data safe comes before any reinstall.

options.text: Take out the RAM to reset the PC
options.why: The timing points to the update, not the memory, and removing parts adds risk.

hints: What changed just before this started?
Does Windows have tools that run before Windows starts?
What must be safe before you try anything drastic?
real_world_tip: After two or three failed starts, Windows usually opens the recovery screen by itself. From there, Advanced options has Startup Repair, Uninstall Updates and System Restore.
